contracts.actual_behavior: Registered actors constructing ModPathNavigation use WalkNodeEvaluator with canPassDoors=true and custom PathFinder. Native search delegates parent; wraps copied nodes into PatchedPath with target=mob.blockPosition and reachesTarget=false, nextNodeIndex initially0. PatchedPath.getPosition is an old separate signature; native Path positions are resolved independently in pinned vanilla declarations. followThePath scans backward up to next elevation change for shortcut. sweep computes traversal arrays but ALWAYS returns true, performs NO collision/world query; first candidate later node sets next index and returns false, so normal node advance is skipped that tick. If no shortcut, strict XZ distance<.5 and Y<1 advances, or elevation-change threshold width*.5. Final moveTo reassigns current temp position/current rotation. No new damage. BodyRotationControl.clientTick is native AI invoked despite name. Movement delta XZ squared>float2.5000003E-7 sets body to entity yaw and clamps head to native maxHeadYRot. Stationary with no first Mob passenger: head change>15 resets counter and clamps body; otherwise count++, limit75 for first10 then max(1-(counter-10)/10,0)*75; approach=target+clamp(wrapDegrees(current-target),-limit,limit)*.55. Histories shift but never receive current positions. Orientation remains material to independently reviewed attack arcs; no automatic new arc payload.

contracts.actual_behavior: Client-only camera hooks: allowCameraShake and unpaused gates nearby CameraShakeEntity effects within inflated20 and strict own radius, sums attenuation and caps1; pitch+=A*cos((tick+delta)*3+2)*25, yaw similar5+1, roll similar4. STUN independently adds amplitude(1+amplifier)*.01 using same cos terms×25 OUTSIDE config/paused gate; PHARAONS_CURSE adds roll180 independently, despite base periodic scheduling false. Detached capture camera zoom Skeloraptor6, Mimic/Thrown/bigbullet/Pursuer/Paladin/Obliterator8. DynamicCameraZoomEntity applies radius eligibility and 4*livingScale+interpolatedzoom, last iterated match wins; allowCameraZoom/unpaused gate. setCameraLockedOn computes pitch/yaw but never applies setters, so locked flag does not aim camera. Post player tick forces THIRD_PERSON_BACK while reviewed capture vehicle isVehicle (Obliterator excludes attack18/19/20), saves previous type and restores after exit. Native UUID blocked-render list cancels rendering/post event except first-person camera entity; it does not remove actor or cancel server damage. Render portals/GUI boss bars only draw. Camera shake is presentation control, no actor knockback or additional damage.
